assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production boss animation sprite sheet, original pixel-art fantasy RPG. Match EXACT midnight-blue storm dragon with turquoise wings, silver horns and armored face in reference, now orange fire glowing in throat. Create 12 full-body poses in strict 4 columns by 3 rows, equal square cells, transparent background. All face right three-quarter side, same feet baseline and camera, same body size, exact identity. Columns sequential within each row. Row1: four breathing idle poses, subtle chest inflate/deflate, tail curl and wing flex. Row2: four heavy walking poses, left leg advance, weight transfer, right leg advance, weight transfer. Row3: four distinct poses: turning head toward viewer, head tilted away, hurt recoiling with wings tense, phase-change roar standing tall. Entire dragon including wings/tail fully inside each cell with margins. Strong crisp pixel art, no scenery, no text, no grid. 2048x1536 canvas with 512px cells if possible. Directly sliceable game frames, never a concept poster. Keep dragon width/height consistent except intentional pose changes.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: attack animation sprite sheet for original pixel-art fantasy RPG boss. EXACT same midnight-blue dragon, turquoise wing membranes, silver horns and armored face from reference. Orange fire throat. Strict 4 columns by 3 rows, equal 512px cells on 2048x1536 canvas if possible. Same scale, body location and feet baseline in every cell, all face RIGHT three-quarter side. Row1 sequential breath attack: 1 head rises mouth shut orange throat, 2 jaws open charging, 3 leans forward exhaling with tiny flame at mouth, 4 continuous exhale head lower slightly toward viewer. NO long fire beam outside mouth, beam rendered separately. Row3: 1 phase roar wings lifted, 2 wounded collapse on knees, 3 dying leaning down wings folding, 4 dead fully collapsed on ground. Full silhouette never cropped or touching neighboring cells. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no gradients, no floor shadows, no scene, no text, no grid lines. Consistent readable pixel art, not a painted illustration.
